verdict_reason: This is a proxy-only task with no source paper, so the reference is its own documented estimand -- cosine geometry over embedding rows -- and BOTH blocking defects from my round-4 verdict are now closed. (a) `_compute_separation` no longer calls `scipy.spatial.distance.cosine` on float32 rows; it routes through `safe_unit_rows` and takes 1 - u.v (categories.py:204-222). On an exact orthogonal construction it returns intra = 0.8571428571428571, inter = 1.0 and separation = 0.1428571428571429 at ALL SEVEN contract scales including 1e-30 and 1e20, where the old path returned exactly 0.0 for any magnitude <= 1e-19; on a random float32 cloud the separation is invariant to 1.55e-07 relative across 1e-30 to 1e20. (b) The first-wins-by-JSON-order labelling is gone: reordering the asset (swapping pronouns/determiners AND units/prepositions, and separately moving the relation category present_past to the front) changes ZERO of the emitted numeric keys, against the previously measured pronouns_purity -23.6% / determiners_purity +45.9% / pronouns_purity_matched +120%. I enumerated every pairwise category token-id collision independently of the first-wins rule and found exactly two -- pronouns<->determiners (12 ids: ' that', ' their', ' these', ' this', ' those', ' your', ...) and prepositions<->units (2 ids: 'in', ' in') -- totalling the 14 that `_meta_n_ambiguous_tokens` reports and drops. Purity is exactly scale-invariant (0.22222222222222224 at every one of the seven scales), and all 14 gpt2 hub_skew values are genuine non-degenerate numbers (-0.3274 to +1.6976). The remaining zero-variance hub_skew convention (0.0 where scipy.stats.skew gives NaN) is structurally reachable only for a category of exactly 5 or 6 tokens, where k = min(5, m-1) = m-1 makes the occurrence vector constant by construction; the smallest scored category across gpt2, distilgpt2, pythia-70m, pythia-160m, SmolLM2-135M and gpt2-medium is 10 tokens (SmolLM2 digits; currencies is 11 to 14), so the branch does not fire in this zoo. RECORDED DISAGREEMENT: the concurrent codex round-5 verdict holds this task at YELLOW solely on that zero-variance branch, constructing a synthetic six-row category to trigger it. I reproduce their trigger exactly (a 6-token category gives n_occ = [5,5,5,5,5,5], std 0.0, and scipy.stats.skew returns NaN) and agree the line should change; I do not treat it as verdict-blocking because it cannot fire on the task's own domain -- across gpt2, distilgpt2, pythia-70m, pythia-160m, SmolLM2-135M and gpt2-medium the category token counts run from 10 (SmolLM2 digits; multi_digit maps to 0 there and is skipped) up to 98, and NOT ONE category anywhere in that panel has m in {5, 6} -- so all 14 emitted gpt2 hub_skew values are genuine (-0.3274 to +1.6976) and none is the fabricated 0.0. One line -- return NaN when n_occ.std() == 0, as the sibling geometry_hubness already does -- removes the disagreement entirely.
comparable_reason: The task declares this itself (`cross_model_comparable: False`, `comparability_note: tokenizer_dependent_category_token_mapping`) and the measurements show it is not a small effect. Over six models the `digits` category maps to 20 tokens on gpt2/distilgpt2/pythia-70m/pythia-160m/gpt2-medium but only 10 on SmolLM2-135M, whose k_eff drops 19 -> 9 and whose digits_purity is consequently EXACTLY 1.000000 against 0.439474 to 0.560526 for every other model -- a tokenizer ceiling artifact, not geometry. `multi_digit` maps to 57/55/24 tokens on GPT-2/Pythia/Llama-class tokenizers but 0 on SmolLM2, so the key vanishes entirely. Even the k-matched, size-matched variant does not repair this: SmolLM2's entire digits category IS the 10-token subsample, so digits_purity_matched is also exactly 1.000000. On top of the population problem, `<cat>_separation` carries un-reported control noise: 30 independent 10-token control draws move seasons_separation over [0.204711453, 0.243675469] with sd 0.010299220 about a mean of 0.223514476, i.e. the control draw alone is 4.61% of the reported value, and only one draw is taken with no interval emitted.
normalized_variant: <category>_purity_matched (all 14, fixed m = 10 and k = 9, blake2b-seeded subsample; emitted UNPREFIXED, while NORMALIZERS has 0 entries)
github_reason: No code was ever released, because there is no source paper: task_metadata.py classes this as 'proxy-only / BLME category geometry' with an empty reference-repo field, and the taxonomy in src/blme/assets/categories.json is BLME's own. There is therefore nothing to fetch. In place of a reference I checked each kernel against an independent construction: an orthogonal-cluster fixture whose exact separation and purity are known in closed form (recovered exactly at all seven scales), an independent enumeration of the category token-id collisions (which reproduced the shipped `_meta_n_ambiguous_tokens` = 14 exactly), and scipy.stats.skew for the hubness statistic.
paper_reason: There is no published number for this quantity anywhere: the BLME manuscript has no geometry_categories subsection at all (grep over sections/*.tex finds it only in the catalogue table), and no external paper defines this taxonomy, this k, or this purity. What is reproducible is the analytic construction: four perfectly separated orthogonal clusters must give purity 1.0 at k <= m-1, and an orthogonal category-vs-orthogonal-control fixture must give inter = 1.0 exactly. Both hold with zero error at every scale.
confounds_reason: Over six locally run models (gpt2, distilgpt2, pythia-70m, pythia-160m, SmolLM2-135M, gpt2-medium) mean raw purity is [0.407280, 0.405727, 0.423711, 0.425000, 0.421834, 0.371976] with rho(vocab) = +0.555, rho(d_model) = -0.638, rho(n_layers) = -0.147 -- but the panel holds only three distinct vocabulary sizes (50257, 50304, 49152), so vocabulary is not identifiable here and I will not upgrade this to CONFIRMED on it. The identifiable confound is not an architecture scalar at all but the TOKENIZER's category population: SmolLM2's digits_purity is exactly 1.000000 purely because its category has 10 tokens and k_eff falls to 9. That is a population effect, and it is the one the task itself warns about.
defects: CODE/GLOBAL STATE, categories.py:184, 390, 474: three `np.random.seed(42)` calls on the process-global legacy numpy RNG, one of them INSIDE the per-category loop of `_compute_relation_consistency`. Measured end to end: seeding numpy at 1234 and then running this task moves the next global draw from 0.1915194504 to 0.8747470735 (delta 0.6832276231), so every later task in the same process inherits a reset stream. This does not change THIS task's own values -- they are deterministic -- but it is a cross-task reproducibility defect, and the matched-purity subsample in the same file already uses `np.random.default_rng`.

PROTOCOL, categories.py:192-223: `_compute_separation` draws 100 non-category tokens and then uses only `random_tids[:10]`. The 10-token control carries real noise -- 30 independent draws give seasons_separation sd 0.010299220 on a mean of 0.223514476, i.e. 4.61% -- and no interval is emitted. The 90 discarded draws are also wasted. `inter` is additionally a misnomer: it is a category-vs-random-vocabulary contrast, not a between-category one.

NORMALIZED VARIANT, categories.py:269-302: the 14 `*_purity_matched` keys are emitted UNPREFIXED and are feature-eligible, but they do not remove the tokenizer dependence they exist for. SmolLM2-135M's digits category has exactly 10 tokens, so the m=10 subsample is the whole category and digits_purity_matched is exactly 1.000000, the same ceiling artifact as the raw key; and over the six-model panel the matched mean has rho(vocab) = -0.926 against the raw mean's +0.555, i.e. the association is relocated rather than removed. They should carry `_meta_` until a shared word/candidate population plus a chance correction passes a direct test.

CODE (latent), categories.py:329-331: `0.0 if n_occ.std() == 0 else skew(n_occ)` reports a legal skewness of 0 (meaning 'symmetric') for a statistic that is 0/0, where scipy.stats.skew and the sibling geometry_hubness kernel both return NaN -- the sibling was changed to NaN in round 3 and its parity test pins that against scipy. The branch is structurally certain for a category of exactly 5 or 6 tokens (k = min(5, m-1) = m-1 makes every token a neighbour of every other, so hub_max is also a constant m-1) but no category in the six tokenizers I checked has m in {5, 6} (the minimum scored size is 10), so it is latent.

CODE (latent), categories.py:160-175: the ambiguity scan builds `_claims` only from string items (`if not isinstance(_w, str): continue`), so it skips RELATION categories entirely. In the shipped asset there is no word shared between a relation category and a flat one (I checked all pairs: 0 shared words, 0 shared token ids), so the first-wins rule is inert today -- but a future asset edit that put a word in both would silently reinstate the order dependence this fix removed.

PROTOCOL, categories.py:396-406: analogy quartets are enumerated exhaustively below n = 20 pairs and sampled 200 times WITH REPLACEMENT at or above it, a discontinuity at exactly the boundary (n=19 gives 342 distinct ordered pairs, n=20 gives 200 draws). On gpt2 singular_plural has 21 pairs and present_past 49, so both take the sampled path and duplicate draws re-weight the estimate. The number of distinct quartets actually evaluated is not emitted.

PIPELINE, categories.py:88-91: `cross_model_comparable` (a constant False) and `comparability_note` (a string) are emitted UNPREFIXED alongside the 100-plus numeric keys, so the warning does not gate anything and contributes a zero-variance column.
fix: 1) Replace the three `np.random.seed(42)` calls with local `np.random.default_rng` instances so the task stops resetting the process-global stream (measured delta 0.683 on the next global draw). 2) Prefix all 14 `*_purity_matched` keys with `_meta_` until the matched design actually removes the tokenizer effect -- as shipped, SmolLM2's digits reads exactly 1.0 in both the raw and the matched key. 3) Return NaN, not 0.0, for a zero-variance category hub skew, matching geometry_hubness and scipy. 4) Include relation-category words in the ambiguity scan so the first-wins rule cannot return through an asset edit. 5) Draw only the 10 control tokens actually used, average over several control draws, and emit the control standard deviation (4.61% of the reported separation on gpt2 seasons); rename `inter` to something that says category-vs-random-vocabulary. 6) Sample analogy quartets without replacement under one rule at all n and emit the evaluated count. 7) Move `cross_model_comparable` and `comparability_note` under `_meta_`, or make them gate feature selection.
